gloss: late-night work; night shift; graveyard shift

definitions.gloss: late-night work; night shift; work performed during late-night hours
definitions.explanation: Work carried out during late-night hours, typically defined in Japanese labor law as 10 PM to 5 AM. This can refer to a regular night shift at a workplace or to working late at the office. Under Japanese labor standards, late-night work commands a premium wage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{深夜勤務|しんやきんむ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: I have a lot of night shifts this week.

examples.japanese: {深夜勤務|しんやきんむ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{割増|わりまし}→割増：17087_warimashi⟧⟦{賃金|ちんぎん}→賃金：04842_chingin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{支払|しはら}われる→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: Premium pay is given for late-night work.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{深夜勤務|しんやきんむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れて→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I was doing late-night shifts at a convenience store, so my daily rhythm fell apart.

notes:
Combines ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧ (late at night) and ⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧ (work, duty). A formal compound used in workplace and labor contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深夜勤務|しんやきんむ}{手当|てあて}: late-night work allowance
- {深夜勤務|しんやきんむ}⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧: after finishing a night shift
- {深夜勤務|しんやきんむ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: night shifts continue
- {深夜勤務|しんやきんむ}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: prohibition of late-night work

USAGE:
Common in industries that operate around the clock — convenience stores, hospitals, factories, transportation, and security. Japanese labor law (⟦{労働基準法|ろうどうきじゅんほう}→労働基準法：17911_roudoukijunhou⟧) mandates a 25% wage premium for work performed between 10 PM and 5 AM.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{夜勤|やきん}→夜勤：09549_yakin⟧: night shift — shorter and more colloquial, the most common word for working at night
- ⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧: overtime — working beyond regular hours, not necessarily at night
- ⟦{徹夜|てつや}→徹夜：03552_tetsuya⟧: staying up all night — can be for work, study, or other purposes; emphasizes not sleeping
